step_plan.notes: Tooling-only, no src/ changes. See progress/ocr-improvement.md log entry 2026-08-22 for full acceptance-criteria checklist, baseline table, and findings (recall@retrieval=100% across the board; no_match_rate(oov)=0% confirms the documented 'cutoff never fires' symptom; false_top1_rate=0% everywhere). npm test has 118 pre-existing unrelated failures (design-token runtime errors, confirmed via git diff to predate this step); tsc --noEmit is clean.

ProductQuery type added (types.ts); searchConfig.ts created with all 8 SEARCH_CONFIG keys, only segmentOcrQuery active this step; ProductRepository.search() takes ProductQuery (brand/name joined) instead of a raw string, all 3 real callers migrated (CaptureFlowScreen/AddProductHubScreen/FirstProductScreen), no string overload kept; buildOcrProductQuery() added to ocrNormalizer.ts (pure, unit-tested) wrapping splitLabelText + empty-name-fallback guard; scripts/search-eval/run.ts updated in sync (ported splitLabelText, buildSearchText() gated on segmentOcrQuery, ACTIVE_CONFIG_KEYS extended). tsc clean, npm test 118 failing/2204 passing (identical to Step 0 baseline, no new failures). Harness re-run: typed set byte-identical to Step 0 baseline (verified per-case, not just aggregate); label set also byte-identical (0 of 49 cases changed at all) because toTrigrams() tokenizes newlines and spaces identically, so brand+name-joined and raw-blob decompose into the same trigram set on this fixture set -- step's value is purely structural (gives step 2 a brand/name split to score), exactly as the spec predicted. Full before/after table and per-case diff methodology in progress/ocr-improvement.md 2026-08-22 second log entry.

scoreCandidate.ts (scoreField/scoreCandidate, 3-rule token matcher, short-query guard) + typedRanking.ts (5-tier classifier + deterministic tiebreak) + textNormalize.ts (normalizeForMatch) added; ProductRepository.search() rewritten: retrieveCandidates() (public, pre-cutoff recall stage, origin-branched: OCR=trigram FTS, typed=word-boundary-prefix LIKE with a tier-5 fuzzy-FTS supplement) + score/cutoff/tier stage, all gated behind SEARCH_CONFIG.scoringV2 with a legacySearch() fallback reproducing pre-step-2 behaviour byte-for-byte (verified via harness: 0 fixed/0 broken vs the step-0 baseline with scoringV2=false). ScoredCorpusProduct (CorpusProduct & {score}) added to types.ts; the 3 screen call sites needed no changes (structural typing). Eval harness (scripts/search-eval/run.ts) rewritten to import real src/ modules via new tsx devDependency instead of hand-mirroring logic -- tsx confirmed to resolve @/ aliases and TS constructor-property syntax with zero config. 9-point minMatchScore sweep (0.30-0.70) run against the live corpus; chosen minMatchScore=0.55 (lowest threshold where false_top_1 reaches 0%; identical metrics to 0.60 but a longer candidate list at no cost). tsc clean; npm test 118 failing/2242 passing (same 118 pre-existing failures, +38 new passing tests). Full sweep table, before/after metrics, per-case diff, and step-3-necessity judgment (NOT necessary -- false_top_1 is 0% and every residual precision@1 miss is same-brand, never cross-brand) in progress/ocr-improvement.md.

Human decision 2026-08-23, per 00-README.md's own gate ('skip if step 2 already fixed false_top_1'). Evidence: false_top_1 = 0.0% at the chosen threshold (0.55) and at every swept value >=0.55; every one of the 11 step-2 per-case regressions plus the brand-only-fix follow-up were individually investigated and none is cross-brand -- all same-brand product-line confusion or corpus-duplicate rows. Brand-first hard filtering would not address either failure mode. See progress/ocr-improvement.md step 2 log entry's 'Step 3 -- is it still necessary?' section for full reasoning.

stopwords.ts added (COSMETIC_STOPWORDS, 78 entries fr/en/pl/ru, seeded from LATIN_COMMON_TERMS minus function/category words like cleanser/toner/moisturizer/sunscreen, plus body-area/claim/filler hand additions); scoreField (scoreCandidate.ts) split query tokens into content/generic with 0.85/0.15 weighting + renormalization when generic is empty + GENERIC_ONLY sentinel with exact-full-name exception, gated behind SEARCH_CONFIG.stopwordsEnabled; scoreCandidate's all-generic-query handling added per the doc's own §3 assignment (0.35/0.65 blend itself untouched). Design decision: the !query.brand branch (every typed query, post brand-only-fix) has no second field to fall back to, so an all-generic query there returns 0 per the doc's top-level rule, not §3's two-field fallback (which only applies to the OCR/brand-set branch). Found and fixed 2 issues during testing: (1) first-pass stopword list included function words (cleanser etc.) that broke a pre-existing unit test (plain 'cleanser' query returning 0 results) -- re-curated down from ~125 to 78 entries, texture/format words only; (2) harness re-sweep found 'et' (French 'and') missing from filler words, causing 2 generic OCR fixtures to surface spurious matches -- added. minMatchScore re-swept and moved 0.55 -> 0.65 (false_top_1 is 0% at every threshold now, so the old tie-break criterion no longer discriminates; 0.65 is the highest threshold with zero real-match cost, verified strictly better than 0.55/0.60 via --compare). tsc clean; npm test 118 failing/2255 passing (same 118 pre-existing failures, +11 new tests). Harness vs brand-only-fix baseline: 0 fixed/0 broken (net-neutral on this fixture set; qualitative improvement confirmed via unit tests rather than this fixture set's aggregate, which under-represents generic-noise collisions). Full writeup, sweep table, and the c042/c048 investigation in progress/ocr-improvement.md's 2026-08-23 step-4 log entry.
